message.description:
A message from a Podium conversation. Messages include each exchange within a conversation and include
conversations for all channels within Podium (Facebook Messenger, SMS text, GMB, etc).

## Deprecations

The `contact` and `sender` object fields have been deprecated, they are currently only available in webhook
and will be completely removed at some point in the future.

attachmentUrl.description: URL of message attachment. This field is deprecated, please refer to the attachmentUrl in the items array.

contact.description: To whom the message was sent or from whom it was received.

externalIdentifier.description: Identifier of the contact that is used external to Podium.

conversation.description: The conversation to which the message belongs.

channel.description: Channel that the conversation is in.

identifier.description: Identifies the Messenger channel. Must be a valid email address or a phone number. Non-US/Canada numbers must include the country code (e.g. +61 for AUS)

failureReason.description: If the message failed to send, this will be the reason.
failureReason.example: Attempted to send SMS to a landline.

items.description: A list of all items associated with the message uid. This includes text bodies and attachments.

attachmentContentType.description: MIME type of the message attachment.

attachmentUrl.description: Public URL of the message attachment. NOTE: There is an expiry of 7 days on this URL.

createdAt.description: When the message item was created.

encryptedAt.description: When the item was encrypted. `null` if the item is not encrypted.

sendBody.description: The send body of the message item that the end consumer sees.

sourceType.description: The source type of the message item.

type.description: The type of the message item.

uid.description: Podium unique identifier for message item.

location.description: Location from which the message was sent or to where the message was sent.

sender.description: If the message was sent from Podium then this will be the Podium user who sent it.

senderUid.description: Podium unique identifier for user. If the message was sent from Podium then this will be the Podium user who sent it.

webchatUrl.description: The page URL where the webchat widget was submitted from. Only present when the message originated from a website widget.
